brief:
Israeli attacks have killed five Palestinians in Gaza over the past 48 hours, Middle East Eye reported. Rescue workers have simultaneously recovered 11 bodies from beneath rubble across the enclave, according to figures from the Gaza Health Ministry tracking the toll from ongoing strikes.

The deaths represent the latest wave of casualties in the conflict. Recovery operations have continued as rescue teams work through damaged sites where structures have collapsed under fire. The Health Ministry maintains an active count of fatalities and those pulled from debris as operations proceed across the territory.

title: Israeli attacks kill five Palestinians as rescuers dig through Gaza rubble
